name: pi-revdiff-plan
description: Pi plan mode with revdiff TUI review

scripts.build: mkdir -p /tmp/pi-build && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir /tmp/pi-build index.ts && cp /tmp/pi-build/index.js ./index.js
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run test
